notes.title: ver2.06 update
notes.notes:
The following additions and corrections have been made.

・ Replacement of title logo
・ Additional Russian
・ Adjust enemy
・ Map adjustment

Details
・ Correct the behavior of the apparition of the alarm bell
・ Extended time until attacked by mask bug
・ Change the initial cursor position at death
・ Changed to save special ball at Checkpoint
・ Slightly adjust the attack effects of some enemies
・ Improved behavior of option setting process by slide bar
・ Correct the behavior of the shadow of diffusing hate
・ Reduce health consumption of japanese headband

notes.title: ver 2.05 update
notes.notes:
The following corrections were made.

Correct some enemy strengths downward
Some item effect improvement
Map adjustment
Solve the problem
etc..


Details
・ Replacement of title logo
・ Increase camera's stun time
・ Correcting the moving speed of the apparition of clairvoyance
・ Disruption of UI display due to difference in screen ratio
・Adjustment the number of enemy appearances on some stages in Path of Asuras mode
・Adjustment of the map of some stages
・ Problems when warping at some stage
・ Problems related to the event scene on stages 5 and 7
・ Enemy may not respond to firecracker under specific circumstances
・Correction of behavior and display in the start menu
・ Adjustment and correction of UI during game play
・ Improved the behavior of the apparition of the alarm bell
・Eliminate the error when hitting crystal on Shoji
・ Improved enemy behavior when using crystal
・ When using a lizard's tail, if it is just 50, you will die after warping
・ Fix the broken door not to affect the use of the camera
・ Others, fine adjustment

notes.title: ver2.03 update
notes.notes:
The following problems have been resolved
・ UI is not displayed properly with some screen ratios

The following adjustments were made
・ Adjust some item effects
・ Some map adjustment
・ Correct the spawn timing of certain enemies on stage 6

notes.title: ver2.02 update
notes.notes:
The following problems have been resolved.
・The game freezes when switching to full screen.
・Warp out of the stage when using an item with a warp effect.
・When the game is started, the previously set key configuration is not read.
・Trouble when skipping an event at a particular stage.
・Items do not spawn in the beginner Mode at a particular stage.


The following adjustments were made.
・Corrected the difficulty of the beginner mode downward.

notes.title: ver 2.01 update
notes.notes:
The following issues have been resolved.
· Starting from the checkpoint, the game will stop with an error.
· When you use a mirror, you sometimes get stuck.
· Depending on the event scene, the progress of the game may stop.
· Some of the English and Korean translations were displayed as Japanese.

· Other fine adjustments.
